lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters are arranged in a series of roughly horizontal rows across the mid-flank; the spatial density of these centroids is higher in the anterior region near the gills and decreases as the clusters become larger and more spaced out towards the posterior.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs at near-perpendicular angles, creating a grid-like series of anchor nodes across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal linear features are visible across the flank; each is defined by a sharp vertical luminance gradient consisting of a high-intensity upper ridge edge and a lower-intensity shadowed ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin displays a pattern of high-luminance blobs distributed across its dorsal surface.
